title: Amarillo A Series Double Reduction Gearbox
description: The Amarillo A Series Double Reduction Gearbox. Cooling tower replacement parts from ICST.

layout.title: Amarillo A Series Double Reduction Gearbox

paragraphs: The Double Reduction “A” Series Gear Drives for cooling towers from Amarillo Gear Company are designed as direct replacements for the Marley® right angle gear boxes. Since there are no differences in the critical mounting dimensions, the “A” Series will make Marley® gear box replacements easy.
